title: context
summary: Returns a compact context bundle for a symbol -- its doc comment, class surface (signatures), the target's own body, and a capped list of callers
intro: Read this before editing or explaining a symbol. context returns a compact bundle, its doc comment, class surface, own body and a capped list of callers, so you read a fraction of what a whole-file read costs.

surfaces.usage: drag-lint context --task "verb qname" [--db <file.sqlite>] [--format md|json|raw] [--no-docs] [--full-surface] [--library-db <library.sqlite>] (AI-ready symbol bundle: doc + class surface + the target body + capped callers. When the task phrase matches a dl:wiki topic ALIAS, up to 2 topics ride along as a "## Wiki" section -- suppressed by --no-docs. A qname that resolves to nothing now exits 1 and SAYS so)
help: drag-lint context            --task "verb qname" [--db <file.sqlite>] [--format md|json|raw] [--no-docs] [--full-surface] [--library-db <library.sqlite>]   (AI-ready symbol bundle: doc + class surface + the target body + capped callers. When the task phrase matches a dl:wiki topic ALIAS, up to 2 topics ride along as a "## Wiki" section -- suppressed by --no-docs. A qname that resolves to nothing now exits 1 and SAYS so)

a whole TYPE target keeps its method bodies up to --max-body-tokens estimated tokens (default 20000; 0 = uncapped): a FOCUS method named after the type ("modify TFoo Bar") first, then the most-called-in-type, then the smallest; the rest are listed as header + line range under "## Omitted bodies" (json body_cap, bodies_omitted, omitted_bodies). A member target is never cut (CTX-TYPECAP)
--library-db also counts, in the Library calls line, the calls whose receiver type the library binds now (json library_calls.via stored|oracle).

a method reached only THROUGH an interface also gets "## Callers via interface dispatch (IFoo.Bar): N site(s)" sections, after the direct callers; --format json gains "via_dispatch" [{via,kind,sites}] (present only when non-empty) (RB-5)

pitfalls: ~60x leaner than the source. Add --full-surface ONLY for DFM/component/event work.
A WARNING: STALE INDEX line (stale-anchor chunk) means the unit changed since it was indexed: no body is shown. Reindex, then ask again.

questions.ask: What do I need to read before editing this symbol?
How many library routines does this routine call, when the project index has no stored library links?
Can I get the bundle without doc comments?
The bundle for a whole class is huge -- how do I get it smaller, or get every body?

notes: issued by the plugin from GetActiveEditorInfo (DragLint.Plugin.Editor.pas)
